Canada just announced its new National Council on Artificial Intelligence.

I'm not one to carry water for the government but take a look at the people around the table:

• @professor_ajay — U of T professor; founder of Creative Destruction Lab and NextAI.

• @Yoshua_Bengio — Turing Award winner; pioneer of deep learning; founder of Mila.

• @FidlerSanja — co-founder & CEO of Veeda AI; former VP of AI Research at NVIDIA; co-founder of Vector Institute.

• @JohnGrisham — President & CEO of CPP Investments.

• @ghadfield — Johns Hopkins professor specializing in AI alignment, governance and law.

• @JordanJacobs10 — co-founder of Radical Ventures, Vector Institute and Layer 6 AI, which was acquired by TD.

• EricLamarre — MIT lecturer; former head of McKinsey Technology & AI in North America; co-author of Rewired.

• @vpisano_mila — President & CEO of Mila, one of the world’s major AI research institutes.

• Senator @tompitfield — founder of Data Sciences; technology entrepreneur and former Principal Secretary to PM Carney.

• Jody Thomas — former National Security and Intelligence Advisor to the Prime Minister and former Deputy Minister of National Defence.

• Louis Vachon — former CEO of National Bank; now Operating Partner at J.C. Flowers.

• Michelle @zatlyn — co-founder & President of Cloudflare.

• Patrick Pichette — former Google CFO; now CEO of Digital Transformation Canada.

That is a very high concentration of experience across frontier AI research, commercialization, capital, financial services, technology infrastructure, government and national security.

Great to see them all stepping up for Canada.
